name: mixtape
title: Mixtape
description: A rapper and MC theme drawn as a cassette inlay card — white card, black ruled lines, typewriter entries under tiny geometric captions and a band of teal tape-pack stripes — whose shows list is the inlay's track panel: dates numbered A1 to B5 under Side A and Side B, three tick-boxes a line with the status crossed and a sold-out date's ticket slot struck through.

tokens.--font-type: the typed entries: body text, page titles, show cities and dates, the artist's name
tokens.--font-caps: the printed captions in tiny geometric capitals: Side A and Side B, track numbers, tick-box labels, menu, field labels, section headings, ticket links
tokens.--text-xs: caption size: tick-box labels, menu, field labels, ticket links, pagination
tokens.--text-s: small text: dates and venues on the track lines, side labels and track numbers, section headings, footer
tokens.--text-l: show cities on the track lines, values on the show card, post titles in lists, the artist's name
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of titles, track lines and captions
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the geometric captions (wide)
tokens.--weight-caps: how heavy the small captions are
tokens.--color-bg: the card: inlay white in light, smoked case plastic in dark
tokens.--color-text: typed text, the border of a crossed tick-box, the struck ticket slot of a sold-out show, the focus outline
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text: intro lines, support acts, field captions, the menu, played shows, pagination, footer
tokens.--color-faint: the unticked tick-boxes and their labels, faded so the crossed one stands out
tokens.--color-accent: teal ink: links, ticket links, the crosses in ticked boxes and in the current menu item, the strike through a sold-out show's ticket slot, the quote rule
tokens.--color-rule: the ruled lines under every track line, field, post and section heading, and the heavy rules of the spine, the track panel and the footer
tokens.--color-rule-soft: faint rules: table rows and the dashed edge of code blocks
tokens.--color-stripe: the deep teal stripes of the band across the head of every page
tokens.--color-stripe-pale: the two thin pale stripes at the foot of that band
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of running text
tokens.--gutter: space at the left and right edge of the page
tokens.--num-col: width of the track-number column (A1, B2…)
tokens.--date-col: width of the date column on the track lines from tablet width up
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the heavy rules: the spine, the top of the track panel and the field card, the quote rule
tokens.--band: height of the stripe band across the head of every page
